WITH ViolationsByAgeGroup AS (
    SELECT 
        YEAR(t.gdate_happened) AS violation_year,
        CASE 
            WHEN FLOOR(DATEDIFF(t.gdate_happened, d.birth_date) / 365.25) < 25 THEN '<25'
            ELSE '>=25'
        END AS age_group,
        COUNT(*) AS total_violations,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.violator_id) AS unique_drivers
    FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation t
    JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON CAST(t.violator_id AS BIGINT) = d.id
    WHERE t.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
      AND YEAR(t.gdate_happened) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
      AND d.birth_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY violation_year, age_group
),
AvgViolationsPerDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        violation_year,
        age_group,
        total_violations / unique_drivers AS avg_violations_per_driver
    FROM ViolationsByAgeGroup
)
SELECT 
    v1.violation_year,
    v1.avg_violations_per_driver AS avg_violations_under_25,
    v2.avg_violations_per_driver AS avg_violations_over_25,
    ((v1.avg_violations_per_driver - v2.avg_violations_per_driver) / v2.avg_violations_per_driver) * 100 AS percentage_difference
FROM AvgViolationsPerDriver v1
JOIN AvgViolationsPerDriver v2 ON v1.violation_year = v2.violation_year
WHERE v1.age_group = '<25' AND v2.age_group = '>=25'
ORDER BY v1.violation_year LIMIT 20000;
